failed_assertion_names: the actual Waystones teleport service moves the player to its spawn landing
actual Waystones travel empties and locks the old dungeon
cause: The original fixture placed and owned the destination Waystone, but did not add it to the player discovered-waystone list required by Waystones4.1.0 before teleportation.
correction: The original fixture now invokes the real WaystoneManager.addPlayerWaystone API and explicitly checks the discovered destination before travel.
new_prerequisite_assertion: actual Waystones destination is recorded as discovered before travel
rerun_scope: Only the changed actual-mod fixture was rebuilt and its isolated server run repeated. The production JAR and all other tested inputs were unchanged.
